items.q: How do I verify my identity (KYC)?
items.a: Open Dashboard → Identity verification, fill in your details, upload a passport, ID card or driving licence, and take a live selfie. Our team reviews it and you get an email with the result.

items.q: I didn't receive my verification code.
items.a: Check your Spam and Promotions folders, then use “Resend code” on the verification screen (available every 60 seconds). Codes are valid for 30 minutes.

items.q: How do I add money to my wallet?
items.a: Open Wallet → Add funds and choose card, crypto or bank transfer. Card and crypto top-ups are credited automatically; bank transfers after our team confirms them.

items.q: Can I pay for a property in installments?
items.a: Yes, when the property offers it. The property page shows the down payment, every installment with its date and amount, and you pay each one from your wallet in Dashboard → Installments.

items.q: How do I sell my shares?
items.a: List them on the Secondary Market from your portfolio. When a buyer purchases, the money is added to your wallet and the shares move to the buyer immediately.

items.q: Where are my documents and statements?
items.a: Dashboard → Documents has your certificates and property documents; Dashboard → Reports has official wallet, transactions, investments and owned-properties statements in English or Arabic.
